display.purpose: 28sp / 34sp Bold (-0.03sp tracking) — screen hero titles, large profile numerals, and the AVIA cold-start wordmark.

headline.purpose: 16sp / 21sp SemiBold (-0.01sp tracking) — region headers and modal sheet titles.

title.purpose: 16sp / 21sp SemiBold (-0.01sp tracking) — primary workspace header titles.

title-small.purpose: 12sp / 17sp Medium — AlgoCard algorithm titles and compact toolbar headers.

body.purpose: 12sp / 17sp Normal — step narratives, ChatScreen markdown prose, theory explanations, and code-trace source lines.

body-small.purpose: 10sp / 14sp Normal — card metadata and complexity sub-labels.

label.purpose: 10sp / 14sp SemiBold (+0.08sp tracking) — SectionLabel headers, BottomNavBar labels, PlaybackRail counters/speed, and AttachedDeckTabs.

micro.purpose: 9.5sp / 13sp Normal/Bold — the persistent-text floor for IconPillButton chips, SegmentedToggle options, OfflineBadge, and canvas numerals.

shadows.name: no-shadow
shadows.purpose: Flat-by-default. Depth is conveyed via the 5-step tonal ladder and DoubleBezelShell trays, never drop shadows.

shadows.name: ambient-glow
shadows.purpose: AmbientGlowDivider between regions. Breathes (0.75..1.0) only while isPlaying is true.

shadows.name: cell-glow
shadows.purpose: Sync glow halo (syncGlowRadius = 14dp) while mirroring the active code-trace line.

shadows.name: swap-glow
shadows.purpose: AccentPinkGlow halo behind in-flight cells during swap-arc travel (elevationTraveling = 18dp).

motion.name: panelSpring
motion.purpose: Expanding/collapsing workspace headers and panels via Modifier.smoothPanelExpansion(). 600ms ceiling.

motion.name: panelFadeSpring
motion.purpose: RootStage crossfade (BOOT -> ONBOARDING -> APP) and BootOverlay fade-out.

motion.name: pressSpring
motion.purpose: Modifier.pressPhysics: 4% scale compression (0.96f) + 1dp accent border bloom (0.30 -> 0.60 alpha).

motion.name: cellTravelSpring
motion.purpose: Canvas cell pop-up and horizontal slot shift during swaps.

motion.name: pointerSpring
motion.purpose: Pointer badge hop between array/buffer slots.

motion.name: liftSpring
motion.purpose: Swap-arc lift phase off the origin slot.

motion.name: settleSpring
motion.purpose: Swap-arc settle phase into the destination slot.

motion.name: entryCascade
motion.purpose: One-shot screen mount cascade (max 6 items, 12dp rise, closes permanently after 540ms).

narrative.overview:
AVIA (shipped product name; repository and Kotlin package remain AlgoLens) opens the way a developer opens their editor or hardware logic analyzer: a deep tech-noir dark workspace, JetBrains Mono across every typographic role, semantic signal accents, and zero marketing fluff. The user is treated as an operator who already lives in an IDE—the visualizer canvas is the live work surface, the docked 3-line peek/expand terminal (InstrumentDeck) is the spec sheet locked in step with execution, and the two-tier PlaybackRail is the precision transport tool.

Every surface is engineered like a physical instrument panel. Cards do not float on drop shadows; they sit as inset core plates inside sunken trays (DoubleBezelShell), framed by 0.5dp–1dp hairlines, ruler-ticked progress meters (InstrumentMeter, InstrumentRule), and a bespoke 1.5dp pure-stroke vector icon set (AlgoGlyphs). Touch feedback is mechanical rather than decorative: every tappable surface compresses by 4% (pressScale = 0.96f) while blooming its 1dp accent border (0.30f -> 0.60f alpha) on a non-bouncy spring (Modifier.pressPhysics).
keyCharacteristics: Dark-only tech-noir palette: DarkColorScheme is the sole theme. No light mode, no warm-sepia mode, and no dynamic OS wallpaper color overrides.

Monospace everywhere: JetBrains Mono (R.font.jetbrains_mono_variable) governs every text step from 28sp hero displays down to the 9.5sp persistent-text floor (AlgoType.microSize), with tabular numerals (tnum) on all live counters.

Double-bezel instrument architecture: Premium surfaces (AlgoCard, DoubleBezelShell, practice cards, AI assistant bubbles, profile bento cells) use a sunken outer tray (#080D1B, 12dp radius) with a 2dp gap around an inset core plate (#0C1526, 11dp radius).

Five semantic accents + two functional escapes: Color is strictly behavioral (Traversal Cyan, Tracking Purple, Mutation Pink, Verified Green, Pivot Yellow, plus Warn Red for errors/hard difficulty and Data Orange for data structures/streaks/offline status).
Bespoke 1.5dp stroke iconography (AlgoGlyphs): Hand-authored Lucide-style 24dp vectors with 1.5dp round-cap/round-join strokes and zero fills.

Tactile press physics & one-shot entry cascade: Modifier.pressPhysics provides spring-driven compression + border bloom without idle graphicsLayer overhead; EntryCascadeProvider choreographs only the first 6 visible list items on initial screen mount (540ms window) and becomes a zero-allocation no-op during scrolling.

Unified Live Narrative Stage + Docked Terminal: The visualizer stage lifts its canvas smoothly (160dp peek <-> 319dp expanded) above a docked terminal with attached Trace | State window tabs while burying the stationary StageLegend underneath on expansion.

rules.name: The Functional-Accent Rule
rules.body: Every accent color has a strict behavioral job. Hardcoded Color(0xFF...) literals outside ui/theme/Color.kt are blocked by HardcodedHexColorDetector.

rules.name: The Paired-Container Rule
rules.body: Every translucent accent fill (*Subtle at 0x1F / ~12% alpha) must be paired with a border and foreground derived from the same accent family.

rules.name: The Color-Is-Never-Only Rule
rules.body: Algorithmic and interactive states are never communicated by hue alone; always pair with a pulsing border, explicit pill, or 6dp status dot.

rules.name: The No-Body-Text-Cyan Rule
rules.body: PrimaryCyan (#00E5FF) is reserved for borders, badges, short metric values, wordmarks, and active controls—never long-form body prose.

rules.name: The Monospace-Everywhere Rule
rules.body: JetBrains Mono is the sole font family in the application. Vary FontWeight, step size, or text token—never the typeface.

rules.name: The 9.5sp Persistent-Text Floor Rule
rules.body: AlgoType.microSize (9.5sp) is the minimum permitted text size anywhere in persistent chrome or canvas callouts.

rules.name: The Case-Signal Rule
rules.body: SectionLabel uses Sentence case; inline status pills and header algorithm names use UPPERCASE; card titles and nav tabs use Title Case.

rules.name: The Tabular-Numeral Rule
rules.body: Live-updating step counters and percentages must set fontFeatureSettings = 'tnum' to prevent layout jitter.

rules.name: The Strict 4dp Grid Rule
rules.body: Every padding, gap, and offset must reference AlgoTokens.space1–space8 (2dp to 32dp).

rules.name: The Dock-Lift & Static-Legend Rule
rules.body: VisualizerHost pads its bottom by animatedDockHeight (160dp <-> 319dp) to lift smoothly on terminal expansion, while StageLegend uses a static 164dp bottom padding to stay buried underneath.

rules.name: The One-Shot Entry Cascade Rule
rules.body: EntryCascadeProvider choreographs at most the first 6 visible list items inside a 540ms window, then permanently becomes a no-op for scrolled rows.

rules.name: The Plate-In-A-Tray Rule
rules.body: Cards do not float on drop shadows; they sit inside DoubleBezelShell trays (surfaceSunken outer shell + 2dp bezelGap + surfaceCard 11dp inner plate).

rules.name: The Single-Texture Scanline Rule
rules.body: The 3% white 2dp-period horizontal scanline inside AlgoWorkspaceBackground is the only surface texture permitted in the system.

rules.name: The Functional-Breathing Rule
rules.body: AmbientGlowDivider breathes only while isPlaying is true and rests at a static baseline when paused.

rules.name: The Traveling-Is-A-State Rule
rules.body: elevationTraveling (18dp) and AccentPinkGlow are reserved exclusively for in-flight cells during swap-arc animations.

dos: Do source every color, spacing value, corner radius, stroke weight, and spring spec from AlgoTokens (ui/theme/Theme.kt) and AlgoType (ui/theme/Type.kt).

Do wrap cards, bento stats, practice questions, and AI assistant blocks in DoubleBezelShell (or follow its exact surfaceSunken outer tray + 2dp bezelGap + surfaceCard 11dp inner plate geometry, as in AlgoCard).

Do apply Modifier.pressPhysics(shape, accent) after .clip(shape) and .background(...) on interactive buttons, pills, switches, and cards so they share the 4% scale compression and 0.30 -> 0.60 accent border bloom.

Do use AlgoGlyphs (1.5dp stroke, round caps/joins, zero fills) for all workspace icons, and pair RailIconButton sizes strictly with their matching glyph sizes (30dp->14dp, 32dp->14dp, 36dp->14dp/18dp, 42dp->18dp).

Do keep VisualizerHost bottom-padded by animatedDockHeight (160dp peek <-> 319dp expanded) and StageLegend statically bottom-padded (164dp) so expanding InstrumentDeck lifts the visualizer smoothly while burying the legend underneath.
Do run graphify update . after modifying code files to keep the project knowledge graph synchronized.
donts: Don't write raw Color(0xFF...) literals outside ui/theme/Color.kt or raw *.dp padding/spacing literals outside the theme/token layer (HardcodedHexColorDetector and lint rules enforce this).
Don't re-introduce the removed 1-line TraceStrip into VisualizerScreen.kt; InstrumentDeck's docked 3-line peek (126dp) with attached Trace | State window tabs is the sole code-trace and state dock.

Don't introduce a gamified consumer aesthetic (no XP progress bars, confetti, mascots, social leaderboards, or pastel themes) or marketing hero banners; every screen is an offline developer instrument.
Don't add light-mode themes, Material You dynamic wallpaper colors, or drop shadows on resting cards.

Don't place local remember { mutableStateOf(...) } playback or deck state inside VisualizerScreen.kt (AlgolensVisualizerScreenMutation bans this; all visualizer state belongs in VisualizerScreenState) or branch on individual AlgorithmId values inside VisualizerScreen.kt.
Don't allow Modifier.entryCascade to animate items beyond entryMaxItems (6) or after entryWindowMs (540ms); scrolling rows must always compose at rest without allocating offscreen render layers.
